facts.text: The hotel is in the West End near Washington Circle and the White House.

facts.text: The lobby has handcrafted Windsor-style furniture.

facts.text: The hotel has a skylit saltwater pool with a separate hot tub.

facts.text: The Tea Cellar offers more than 30 rare, single-estate teas from China, Japan, Sri Lanka and the Himalayas.

facts.text: Afternoon tea is available at the Tea Cellar.
facts.excerpt: Tea is ordered by the freshly brewed pot and ranges from $8 to $300. Afternoon tea is available.

facts.text: Blue Duck Tavern crafts rustic dishes from locally sourced seasonal ingredients.
facts.excerpt: The Michelin-acclaimed Blue Duck Tavern crafts rustic dishes from locally sourced seasonal ingredients and offers a tasting menu paired with wines from the restaurant's robust cellar.

facts.text: Reservations are strongly encouraged at Blue Duck Tavern.

facts.text: Blue Duck Lounge has glass-enclosed booths beside a marble and glass bar.

facts.text: Blue Duck Tavern is Michelin-starred.
facts.excerpt: the Michelin-starred Blue Duck Tavern and its Tea Cellar, serving more than 30 rare teas, are outright destinations for residents and visitors

facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly, with a dog bed, water bowl and treats on arrival.

facts.text: Valet parking is available for one vehicle per room for a nightly fee.
